name: spine stretch forward v. 2
description: A seated Pilates stretch that rounds the spine forward to lengthen the back and hamstrings.
instructions: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Draw your belly in and flex your feet.
Curl forward one vertebra at a time, reaching over an imaginary ball.
Hold for a breath at the bottom.
Roll back up to tall sitting and repeat.
